name: Pedro Rodríguez
features: dark hair, round boyish face, small frame, deerstalker cap off the car, quiet watchful eyes
bio: The elder of the Rodríguez brothers and the best wet-weather driver of his day. Won Daytona and the BOAC 1000 km at Brands Hatch in a monsoon for Gulf in 1970, lapping the field in the 917K while others tiptoed. Drove everything flat out and never seemed to be trying.
